item.title: Computer Science Education Models I Love
item.description: India is rapidly de-industrializing. The next wave of jobs will have to come from the IT and Tech Industry. I believe India can build a middle class, and a robust economy, with the backbone of software. Software education in India is changing, and I believe good educational models can help expedite this movement. Some I particularly like
